word: She protects her face with a hat.
answer: Ella protege su cara con un sombrero.

word: They respond when the guide calls them.
answer: Ellos responden cuando el guía los llama.

word: We go back a little because we miss a turn.
answer: Retrocedemos un poco porque pasamos una vuelta.

word: I break a small stick while walking.
You surprise everyone with extra snacks.
answer: Sorprendes a todos con botanas extra.

word: Strange things happen on long trails.
answer: Cosas raras suceden en los senderos largos.

word: He suspends the hike to rest.
answer: Él suspende la caminata para descansar.

word: I fear running out of water.
She coughs a little from the dry air.
answer: Ella tose un poco por el aire seco.

word: Later we are going to sell photos from the trip.
answer: Más tarde vamos a vender fotos del viaje.
